title: Find the Smallest Even Number in an Array
statement: Given an integer array nums, return the smallest even number. If no even number exists, return null.
think: What is the task asking? Find the smallest value among even numbers only.
What is the key operation? Check parity and track the minimum even value.
What wording signals stand out? Smallest, even number.
What is the brute force idea? Collect evens first, then take min.
What is the better/optimal idea? One pass with a best candidate.
What are the edge cases? No even numbers, negative evens, one element.
What is the complexity? O(n) time and O(1) space.
How would I explain it in an interview? I keep the current best even number and update it when I find a smaller even value.
algorithm: If num is even and best is null or num < best -> update best
interview: I would scan the array once, consider only even numbers, and keep the smallest even candidate found so far.
ru: Здесь тоже обычный один проход: смотрим только на чётные и держим минимальное из них.
visualExplanation:
nums = [8, 3, 10, 2, 14]
8 -> best = 8
3 -> skip
10 -> keep 8
2 -> best = 2
14 -> keep 2

important: Assume array always contains an even number
nice: Do not discuss negative even values

gaps: Nice to have: return null when not found
constraints: Assume array may contain positive or negative integers.
whyThisPattern: This is a Linear Scan because we inspect each number once and track the best matching candidate.
whyNotOtherPatterns: Not Sorting, because we only need one answer.
Not Two Pointers, because there is no positional movement logic.
